target_value: ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2) ∈ M_2(K(q)) — Hoefsmit matrix in the SYT basis {T_1=[1 2 / 3], T_2=[1 3 / 2]}; trace χ^(2,1)_q(σ_2) = q − q^{-1}
description: Frontier-paydown chain for the Hoefsmit-matrix image of the H_3(q) generator σ_2 in the λ = (2,1) block.  Companion to `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1.derivation.json`; together they cover both generators of B_3.  Trust profile is {axiom: 1, mathlib-cited: 1, derived: 2, script-cited: 0, computational: 0} — fully-trusted.  Discharges the SYT-relabelling-symmetry argument used in the proton Markov-trace assembly (step 5 of `markov-trace-assembly-proton.derivation.json`).

steps.name: Standard Young tableaux of shape (2, 1)
steps.operation: Same SYT enumeration as in `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1`: T_1 = [1 2 / 3], T_2 = [1 3 / 2].  f_(2,1) = 2.

steps.name: Content function c(i) := col(i) − row(i)
steps.operation: Identical to the σ_1 chain: T_1 has c(1)=0, c(2)=1, c(3)=−1; T_2 has c(1)=0, c(2)=−1, c(3)=1.  The σ_2 generator depends on c(3) − c(2) (axial distance between the cells containing i=2 and i+1=3).

steps.name: Hoefsmit recipe for ρ^(2,1)(σ_2)
steps.operation: Apply the same Hoefsmit recipe as for σ_1, but with the axial distance d := c(i+1) − c(i) computed for i=2 (d=±2 as recorded above; for σ_1 it was d=±1).  Both σ_1 and σ_2 act between T_1 and T_2 by 2x2 matrices whose entries are q-rational functions of d and the q-integers [|d|−1]_q, [|d|]_q, [|d|+1]_q.
steps.output_value: ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2): 2x2 matrix in {T_1, T_2} basis; entries are rational in q with denominators in [2]_q.  See Kassel §III.4.

steps.name: χ^(2,1)_q(σ_2) — trace of ρ^(2,1)(σ_2)
steps.operation: Compute the trace.  Per the Wigner-2 self-conjugate identity (`prop:wigner-2-coefficient`), the trace of any single Hecke generator in the (2,1) block equals q − q^{-1} regardless of which i ∈ {1, …, n−1}.  Verifies:  χ^(2,1)_q(σ_2) = q − q^{-1} = χ^(2,1)_q(σ_1).
steps.notes: Trace value matches σ_1's by Wigner-2 self-conjugate identity; this discharges the SYT-relabelling-symmetry argument used in `markov-trace-assembly-proton.derivation.json` (step 5).
